}}'''Dairaine Saighan''' is a [[Cairhienin]] noblewoman who was made ''[[gai'shain]]'' by the [[Shaido]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Dairaine Saighan}}

== Appearance ==
She is slender, with black hair down to her waist.

== Activities ==
She stands just below the [[High Seat]] of [[House Saighan]].
After being captured by the Shaido, she becomes one of [[Sevanna]]'s personal ''gai'shain''. She becomes one of Sevanna's favorites due to her telling tales on all the other ''gai'shain''. She walks in on [[Faile Bashere]] planning on her escape from [[Malden]]. She is rolled up in carpet and kept an eye on by [[Bain]] and [[Chiad]] until Faile can get away.
